note: In 'blocks Intro, 2 and 3' the coordination joins only 'Intro' and '3', while '2' is tied to 'Intro' as if it described it, so a conjunct is lost.
'o1' is merged with 'red, 90 wide and 45 high' into one nominal with head 'red', so the thing named and the values it gets are one nominal.
In 'make the slice explosion medium' the word 'explosion' is held as a modifier of the clause, splitting the nominal 'the slice explosion'.
The command verb 'darw' (draw) is held as a dependent of 'chairs' and the request is written as a fragment, so the command is lost.
In 'diamond again' the word of order 'again' is held as a dependent of 'orange', but it cannot describe a noun.
In 'a taepred neck metal grey' the colour word 'metal' is made the head of the nominal of 'neck', splitting 'metal grey' and putting the colour into the description of the thing.
In 'low golden hour light' the head 'light' is held as a modifier of the clause and 'hour' is made the head, splitting one nominal.
In 'Let us what values' the word 'us' is a complement of the clause of 'show' instead of 'Let', and 'Let' is written as an interrogative clause.
In 'the bench left, up until' the direction word 'left' is made the verb of a clause, 'up' is held as a marker and 'until' as a discourse word.
In 'should be dotted' the circuit makes 'should' the verb and 'be' the auxiliary, the reverse of what the words say.
In 'then one more' the word of order 'then' is a dependent of 'one' and 'more' is a modifier of the clause, splitting the nominal 'one more'.
In 'new hire signs' the verb 'signs' is held as the head of a nominal, and 'new hire' and 'signs' are made complements of 'happens', so the clause of 'signs' is lost.
In '50 wide and 45 high' the numbers stand as bare complements and 'wide' and 'high' as modifiers joined by a discourse 'and', so which measure goes with which dimension is not written.
In 'one more little well' the noun 'well' and 'more', 'little' are held as modifiers of the clause, splitting the nominal whose head is 'well'.
'Review + Done, labelled Checks' is merged into one nominal with 'labelled' as a dependent, so the participle and the naming are lost.
In 'amke everything look like' the command verb 'amke' (make) is held as a modifier and the message is written as a declarative clause of 'look'.
In 'how about medium grid line width' the linking word 'about' and 'how' are held as dependents of 'width'.
The relation marked 'while' in 'while you're there, set the chart' starts at the clause of 'that's the tweak' instead of the clause of 'set' that follows the comma.
In 'pages 2 and 6' the coordination joins 'pages' and '6', while '2' is tied to 'pages', so '2' is not a conjunct.
In 'the Nadia baby thanks section' the word 'thanks' is part of the section's name but is held as discourse, and the nominal is split.
In 'and blocks one paragraph' the noun 'blocks' (a third property of the document) is made the verb of a declarative clause.
In 'set one quote Main Track' the content word 'quote' is held as discourse, so its place in the request is lost.

'a large red ferris wheel toward the left edge' and 'three blue balloons' are put in a fragment with ellipsis of 'standing', coordinated with the seller's participle, instead of being conjuncts of the list after 'with'.
In 'not there, the dog a size bigger' the negation 'not' and 'there' are held as dependents of 'the dog', so the correction 'not there' is lost.
In 'and finally a letter' the word of order 'finally' is held as a dependent of 'letter'.
The 'then' of 'then nudge the man' is held in the fragment of 'a little cat', and 'just that one move for now' is made a complement of that fragment too.
In 'and then the same view' the word of order 'then' is held as a dependent of 'view'.
In 'Hub 2 3 underline Review' the word 'underline' and the name 'Hub' are merged into one nominal with head 'Review'.
In 'r1, r2 and the arrow a1' the nominals 'r1' and 'r2' are merged into one nominal, so 'r1' is not a conjunct.
In 'and then one block' the word of order 'then' is held as a dependent of 'block'.
In 'level on both the top and bottom edges' the word 'both' is held as discourse, so its place in the nominal of 'edges' is lost.
In 'change a node 400 huge Hub' the word 'huge', which says how the thing should be, is held as a dependent in the nominal of 'Hub'.
In 'make the kid ... face right' the verb 'face' is held as the head of a nominal and no clause has it as verb.
In 'rides 30%, repairs 25%, spares 45%' the items 'repairs' and 'spares' are tied to 'rides' by relations as if they described it, instead of standing side by side.

The coordination of 'how an author submits a draft, two reviewers comment, the editor decides, and the typesetter takes over' has the main clause of 'turn' as a conjunct instead of the clause of 'submits'.
In 'the notes text box centre aligned' the word 'centre' is made the head of the nominal of 'box', though it goes with 'aligned'.
In 'adding up to one hundred percent' the linking word 'to' is held as a dependent of 'percent', and 'and' is held as a discourse word of that clause.
In 'the branch under Left plum' the colour 'plum' is merged with the name 'Left' into one nominal, so the colour becomes part of the place.
The 'instead' that opens 'instead, a small dog down at the bottom' is held as a modifier of the clause of 'keep the rest as it is' at the end.
In 'Week one 20, Week two 30' the second 'Week' is tied to the first 'Week' as if it described it, instead of standing beside it as another item.
'every piece in the group' is made the complement of 'they read as a set', though it stands after the dash as a remark on 'all of the house plants'.
The commands 'make the pie border thick' and 'make the font a bit bigger' are written as nonfinite clauses inside the relation marked 'to' of 'to settle it'.
In 'link Sprint board to todo' the name 'todo' is made the verb of a nonfinite clause, and the commands after 'then' are coordinated with the clause inside 'to make'.
In 'the middle three one place left' the nominal 'the middle three' is merged with the measure 'one place'.
'Target vilet' is a command whose first word 'Target' can be a verb, but it is held as a noun in a fragment, so the command is lost.
The command 'then drop a blue block on top of each yellow block' (imperative) is coordinated with clauses that stand inside the relation marked 'if'.
In 'a dottted Deep Dive Status' the describing word 'dottted' is made the head of a nominal with 'a', and 'Deep Dive Status' is split off as a nominal of its own.
The relation marked 'before' in 'before I forget, set the Chapter heading' starts at the clause of 'it is the top of the document' instead of the clause of 'set'.
In 'redo, please, the last one' the verb 'redo' is held as a discourse word and the command is written as a fragment.
The command 'then leave both walls as they are' (imperative) is coordinated with the clause of 'add', which stands inside the relation marked 'if'.
In 'about an inch in from the left edge' the measure 'about an inch' is not tied to the relation marked 'from' that it measures; the relation starts at the clause.
In 'as a set a hand-width apart' the nominal 'a set' is merged with 'a hand width' and the modifier 'apart' into one nominal.
In 'rather than uneven' the linking word 'than' is held as a modifier of the clause.
In 'the white cube one place right and the black cube one place left' the coordination joins only the two cubes, so which cube goes right and which goes left is lost.
In 'turn da selected one' the nominal is split: 'da' is a nominal of its own, 'selected' a modifier of the clause and 'one' another nominal.
In 'one place right' (twice) the direction word 'right' is held as discourse, so where the shapes go is lost.
In 'its text Main' the name 'Main' is tied to 'a quote block' while 'its text' is made a complement of 'finish', so the pairing of 'its text' with 'Main' is broken.
The relation marked 'to' of 'to settle it' starts at the clause of 'also make the font a bit bigger', and the command 'make the pie border black' is coordinated inside that relation.
The fragment 'a red cape over her dress' clearly shares the verb 'slide' but has no ellipsis, and 'finally', which opens it, is held in the clause of 'slide'.
The fragment 'the average budget over the departments in a bar chart' is what 'display' acts on, but it has no ellipsis and 'display' has no complement.
In 'no, not that' the negation 'not' is held as a dependent of 'that', and the measure '3cm' is held as a modifier.
'level colous' is a command whose first word 'level' can be a verb, but it is held as a dependent of a noun in a fragment.
In 'label it Start here' the name 'Start here' is split: 'Start' is a nominal and 'here' a modifier of the clause.
The command verb 'pllace' (place) is held as a dependent of 'Path' and the first part is written as a fragment.
In 'page 2, page 3 and page 4 sand' the pages and the colour 'sand' are merged into one nominal, and the pages become part of the colour list.
In 'the round node labelled rejected' the participle clause of 'labelled' is tied to 'n3' instead of the node it describes.
